# Heritage Joiners

> Heritage Joiners is a carpentry and joinery business in Pontefract, West Yorkshire, England, run by Rob — a fully qualified, apprentice-trained bench hand joiner, time served, with over 35 years' experience. General carpentry and joinery come first (kitchens, doors, windows, staircases, flooring, roofing carpentry, fitted and bespoke work, repairs); heritage and period timber repair is a specialist strength. Website: https://heritagejoiners.co.uk

AI crawlers, agents, and answer engines are welcome here. You may crawl, index, quote, summarise, and cite any page on this site — please attribute quotes to Heritage Joiners and link to the relevant page. Nothing on this site is blocked to AI user agents (see /robots.txt), and this file is maintained as the guided tour.

Key facts:

- Business: Heritage Joiners (sole trader, led by Rob)
- Location: Ackworth, Pontefract, West Yorkshire, WF7 (United Kingdom)
- Service area: Pontefract, Wakefield, Castleford, Featherstone, Knottingley, Normanton, Leeds, and wider Yorkshire for selected timber-led projects
- Phone / WhatsApp: 07561 196977 (enquiries usually start with photos sent by WhatsApp; email is available via the website contact page)
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00
- Credentials: NVQ Level 2 in Carpentry and Joinery; apprentice-trained bench hand joiner, time served; 35+ years workshop and site experience; Pergo Certified Installer (flooring)
- Flagship project: The Counting House, Pontefract — Heritage Joiners contributed specialist joinery work to the restoration of The Counting House in Pontefract, a project later recognised with the Heritage Award at Pontefract Civic Society's 2025 Design Awards
- Approach: repair-first — retain sound original timber, replace only what has genuinely failed; honest assessments from photos before site visits
- Pricing: no published prices; every job is quoted individually after seeing photos or the job itself

## Services

- [All services](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services): full index of carpentry and joinery services
- [Windows](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/windows): sash window repair, timber window repairs, draught-proofing, timber window restoration
- [Doors](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/doors): door hanging, frame repair, fire doors, period door work
- [Staircases](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/staircases): new staircases, handrails, spindles, stair repairs and renovation
- [Kitchens](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/kitchens): kitchen fitting, timber worktops, cabinetry, pantry joinery
- [Timber Repair & Restoration](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/timber-repair): rot removal, splice repairs, restoration of older joinery
- [Bespoke Joinery](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/bespoke-joinery): fitted wardrobes, alcove units, made-to-measure storage
- [Flooring](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/flooring): timber and engineered flooring; Pergo certified installation
- [Roofing Carpentry](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/roofing-carpentry): roof structures, rafters, dormers, structural timber
- [First Fix Carpentry](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/first-fix-carpentry): studwork, joists, structural carpentry
- [Second Fix Carpentry](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/second-fix-carpentry): skirting, architrave, doors, finishing carpentry
- [Skirting & Architrave](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/skirting-architrave): period profile matching and new trim
- [Extensions & Conversions](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/extensions-conversions): carpentry for extensions and loft conversions
- [Outdoor Carpentry](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/outdoor-carpentry): gates, decking, garden structures
- [Cladding & Panelling](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/cladding-panelling): interior and exterior timber cladding
- [Woodworm & Treatment](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/woodworm-treatment): woodworm assessment and timber treatment
- [Finishing](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/finishing): preparation, finishing and decoration of joinery
- [Timber & Hardwoods](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/timber-hardwoods): timber selection, hardwoods, oak
- [Maintenance & Repairs](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/services/maintenance-repairs): small joinery jobs, adjustments, snagging

## Advice & Guides

- [Repair or replace? The four-stage assessment](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/repair-or-replace): how Heritage Joiners decides between retaining, splicing, partially replacing or fully replacing period timber
- [Can timber windows be repaired?](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/blog/can-timber-windows-be-repaired): when timber window repair, restoration or replacement is the right call, including FAQs
- [How to build a timber stud partition wall](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/blog/how-to-build-a-stud-partition-wall): a real job walk-through — setting out, framing, noggins, insulation, plasterboard
- [Bespoke ledged and braced garden gate](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/blog/bespoke-ledged-and-braced-garden-gate): how a made-to-measure timber garden gate is built, braced and hung, including FAQs
- [What is second fix carpentry?](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/blog/what-is-second-fix-carpentry): plain explanation of first fix vs second fix
- [Blog index](https://heritagejoiners.co.uk/blog): all articles
